new_packages.label: מוֹתָרוֹת וְרָזֵי תּוֹרָה לַחִיצוֹנִים
new_packages.label_en: Surplus Torah and Secrets Given to the External Forces
new_packages.reason: The Rebbe equates three concepts through explicit bechina language in lines 4-5: (1) 'what a person hears above their level of understanding', (2) מותרות (surplus/extras), and (3) רזי תורה שנמסר לחיצונים (secrets of Torah given over to the external forces/chitzonim). These are not cause-and-effect but three descriptions of the same essential reality: the zone of Torah-content that overflows beyond a particular listener's mind. This overflow-zone is not holy surplus — it is the trough from which the klipot feed, making it an evil domain. This package has 3 nodes connected by 2 explicit bechina statements, fully qualifying it as an independent domain.

bechina_edges.proof: מַה שֶּׁאֶחָד שׁוֹמֵעַ יוֹתֵר וּלְמַעְלָה מִמֹּחוֹ וַהֲבָנָתוֹ, זֶה בְּחִינַת מוֹתָרוֹת
וְזֶה בְּחִינַת רָזֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁנִּמְסַר לַחִיצוֹנִים, כִּי יְנִיקָתָם רַק מִבְּחִינַת רָזֵי תּוֹרָה, דְּהַיְנוּ מִמַּה שֶּׁהוּא לְמַעְלָה מִמֹּחַ הָאָדָם

new_packages.good_evil_mirror: The evil mirror of this package is the good domain of calibrated Torah-teaching: the Tzaddik's אמנות (artistry/skill) of matching his words precisely to each listener's level — ensuring that no one hears מותרות. The good domain has no separate bechina package of its own in this Torah; it is the eitza-driving force (the Tzaddik's skill) that eliminates the evil domain's feeding opportunity.

new_packages.label: יִתְרוֹ וְהַקְּלִפָּה הַדַּקָּה
new_packages.reason: The Rebbe states explicitly in line 7: 'יתרו הוא בחינת הקלפה הדקה שבורחת כששומעת ישועות ישראל'. This is a direct, unambiguous bechina equation: Yitro and the thin klipah share the same essential nature. The thin klipah is distinct from the ordinary klipot of Package 1: it is סמוכה להקדושה (adjacent to holiness) and can suckle even from גוף התורה (the body of Torah itself), not only from the מותרות. Yitro is its biblical personification — just as Yitro left before Matan Torah, the thin klipah flees when Torah is given in the context of ישועות ישראל. This package has 2 nodes and 1 explicit bechina equation. Though it has only 2 nodes (below the 3-node threshold for a fully independent domain), it is documented here as a necessary secondary package because it describes a qualitatively distinct evil entity from Package 1, with its own bechina identity and its own behavioral signature.

bechina_edges.proof: יִתְרוֹ הוּא בְּחִינַת הַקְּלִפָּה הַדַּקָּה שֶׁבּוֹרַחַת כְּשֶׁשּׁוֹמַעַת יְשׁוּעוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל

new_packages.good_evil_mirror: The good mirror of this package is מדברים מישועת ישראל (speaking of Israel's salvation), which is the eitza-remedy that causes the thin klipah/Yitro to flee. This good concept exists in the dataset as the eitza-source in the existing reference-1047 edge. The thin klipah is the evil that flees from holy speech about Israel's redemption.

observations:
Torah 47 (LM2) presents a special case: the dataset contains ZERO bechina edges for this Torah (reference 1047). The single existing dataset edge is correctly typed as 'eitza'. However, the Torah text contains three explicit bechina equations (lines 4 and 7), forming two thematic clusters of evil concepts.

Package 1 (מותרות) has 3 nodes and qualifies as a full independent domain per the 3-node threshold: 'what exceeds the listener's mind' = מותרות = 'רזי תורה given to chitzonim' are three bechina-equivalent descriptions of the same zone from which the klipot draw sustenance.

Package 2 (יתרו / קלפה דקה) has 2 nodes and a single explicit bechina equation. It falls below the 3-node threshold but is included because the bechina equation is direct and unambiguous, and the concept is the Torah's structural pivot — the thin klipah is qualitatively different from the ordinary klipot and requires its own package.

The overall structure of this Torah is eitza-heavy rather than bechina-heavy. The Rebbe's teaching is structured as a series of causal chains: sins → klipot → come to hear Torah → want to suckle → feed from מותרות → therefore the Tzaddik needs אמנות. Speaking of ישועת ישראל → thin klipah flees. These are eitza chains. The bechina relationships are definitional: they define what מותרות IS (the level above understanding), and who יתרו IS (the thin klipah). All proposed packages must be added to the dataset as new bechina edges.
